1. **Root cause**: `MpvPlayerOutput._create_arguments()` appended `--title` and the title string as two separate `argv` entries. With mpv 0.32+, `--title <value>` is rejected for dash-dash options (the value must strictly follow an `=`), so mpv exits with an error before ever opening the stream — which is why the user saw the player silently close and streamlink exit with code 0.
